name: magicsword-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to your MagicSword fleet, alerts, policies, and intelligence feeds.
long_description: Use MagicSword conversationally: inspect devices, investigate audit events and alerts, create or clone audit policies, update policy rules, discover computer groups, and preview assignments to selected computers or current group members, create private intelligence feeds, and manage indicators. Requires active MagicSword access and an API key from Settings → API Keys. Free and Enterprise accounts are supported; your key's scopes and plan determine access. Start with read scopes and ask for a proposal before applying changes. New policies start empty in audit mode without device assignments. Policy assignments require a server-issued confirmation token after reviewing the concrete computers and replacement of existing desired policies; agent upgrades and enforcement switches also include confirmation steps.

api_key.title: MagicSword API key
api_key.description: Generate an API key at https://www.magicsword.io/dashboard/settings?tab=api-keys. Start with read scopes for endpoints, alerts, and policies. This is separate from your device enrollment token.
